page.intro: This policy regulates the refund conditions for the services offered by Alsnippets.

audits.title: Audits
audits.p1: WordPress audits are professional diagnostic services. Once the analysis has started, no refunds are made.
audits.p2: If the client decides to hire subsequent work, the cost of the audit is discounted from the final service.

consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.p1: Free consultations do not generate any payment obligation or right to a refund.

services.title: Contracted Services
services.p1: The payment and refund conditions for personalized services will be specifically defined in each agreement.
